experience.title: My last work experience
experience.p1: For the last four and a half years, I’ve worked simultaneously across two verticals of the same company, splitting my role between TusCasasRurales.com and Pentaweb.

p2.after: , I’ve redesigned the rural accommodation marketplace, designed new features such as online booking and checkout, redesigned the traveler and property owner dashboards, and built a scalable Design System in Figma.

p3.after: , I’ve designed corporate websites, custom digital products and web applications for clients across different industries, from requirements and user flows to prototyping and responsive UI design. Across both verticals, I work closely with developers and business teams to turn user needs and business goals into clear, consistent and conversion-focused digital experiences.
